about: The secreta of the formulary “14th Sunday after Pentecost” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Grant us, Lord, we beseech You, that this salutary sacrifice may be not only a cleansing from our sins but also a propitiation of Your divine power. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Your Son, who lives and reigns with You in the unity of the Holy Spirit, God,
